instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain white background, the blonde woman in the long-sleeved lace dress (R1) stands on the left, and the brunette woman in the strapless white lace dress (R2) stands on the right. They face forward, standing close with their arms wrapped around each other's waist, jointly holding a single bouquet of white roses between them. The blonde woman has a neutral expression, while the brunette woman smiles gently. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright studio lighting, creating a clean, high-key look.
